name: sanvio-factory
description: Mods that ship with Sanvio Factory, and the Stelliad plugin pinned to a commit

plugins.name: harness-lens
plugins.description: A line above the prompt showing which part of the harness just acted

plugins.name: github-status
plugins.description: A line above the prompt with the repo's running actions, open pull requests and open issues

plugins.name: factory-dashboard
plugins.description: A pane with the factory's numbers: what's waiting on you, the loop's spend and rework, evals and tokens

plugins.name: factory-floor
plugins.description: A pane showing the loop in focus: what's waiting, what each issue is on, and its pull request

plugins.name: stelliad
plugins.description: Stelliad's skills, pinned to a reviewed commit. Move the pin by editing sha after reading the diff
